name: Rotoscoping
visualIdentity: Supplemental reference, not a directly named source-collection style. Trace or reconstruct actual filmed movement frame by frame, keeping contours, fills, weight, proportions, and simplification consistent. Filters or generated motion alone do not qualify.
suitableUses: Explicitly suited to realistic traced motion from supplied footage. The proposed risograph hybrid fits music videos, documentary vignettes, and editorial films; analytical line overlays suit sports, biomechanics, and dance instruction. Interactive HTML can show a traced sequence with keyboard step controls.
limitations: Requires verified live-action reference; without footage, report the gap. Avoid random edge changes. No intrinsic palette, audio, renderer, or motion recipe is specified. Do not impose stop-motion stepping from the style name. Omit chapter transitions when too short, causally confusing, or incompatible with a continuous shot or loop.
palette: No canonical palette is specified; resolve colors from task, brand, approved source, or existing semantic mappings first. Optional example tokens are background #F1EBDD, foreground #314249, accent #9D8A72. Keep colors discrete; gradients are disabled. Preserve approved colors and subject materials; the accent is decorative only and fails the normal-text contrast target (3.146). Check actual composited frames.
motionAndInteraction: Base motion on source footage and trace it consistently; preserve source movement or use smooth authored layer or puppet motion. For video, derive state from seekable composition time. Optional chapter/story patterns require meaningful stages, synchronized copy, readable holds, coherent reverse/direct seeking, and deterministic state. Interactive scroll maps finite progress to states; use keyboard-accessible controls and reduced-motion key frames.
audio: No fixed soundtrack is prescribed. Choose music, voiceover, vocals, effects, ambience, or silence for the topic and audience; honor supplied choices and assets. Synchronize and mix with picture, preserve speech intelligibility, avoid clipping and competing vocals, and inspect the delivered audio with video.
assetRequirements: Prepare verified live-action reference as transparent, consistently sized and clearly named layers or numbered frames. Krita can draw frames with onion skin and export PNG sequences. Preserve alpha and inspect assets. Python/OpenCV may assist extraction and alignment but does not establish that tracing occurred.
combinations: Use alone for realistic traced motion. Optional style-049 risograph fill uses two inks, fixed grain and registration, consistent simplification, and no extra blue/coral, jitter, third ink, or changing edges. Optional style-109 overlays use one accent for paths derived from traced positions, thinner than contours; avoid invented measurements or obscuring figures. Chaptered-transition and storytelling patterns are optional only when they support the narrative.
productionApproach: Choose a style-specific renderer and motion engine based on assets and fidelity; neither is provided as a dedicated renderer here. HyperFrames is the primary composition/export pipeline; Remotion only if unavailable or a verified limitation blocks a required capability, with reason recorded. Keep visual construction and motion separate from pipeline duties. Deliver editable source, key-frame contact sheet, parameters, and reproducible instructions; inspect key frames and full output.
